post_hoc_reason: The original registered E3 grid ended at entropy=6 and unique_ratio=0.90. This extension was requested after E3 threshold lock and single held-out evaluation, so it cannot alter the original E3 selection, lock, test result, or scientific claim.

immutable_parent_e3.integrity_statement: Parent E3 artifacts are read-only references. This extension does not modify, supersede, or re-evaluate them.

decision_level_input.permitted_use: Descriptive scoring of the 16 post-hoc candidates only.

data_access_policy.held_out_rule: Do not open, hash, parse, aggregate, compare, or re-evaluate held_out_test.csv.gz for this extension.

candidate_grid.rule: samples >= min_samples AND entropy >= entropy_threshold AND unique_ratio >= unique_ratio_threshold

analysis.aggregation: equal-weight macro-average over 2 primary attack conditions x 4 levels

secondary_reporting.role: descriptive only; never a selection constraint

analysis.inference: No new confirmatory CI, p-value, or deployment claim is produced. Values are descriptive validation sensitivity results.

interpretation_guardrails.no_replacement_claim: The candidate with the largest post-hoc delta_J is not a replacement for E3's locked candidate.
interpretation_guardrails.high_threshold_warning: A high delta_J can coexist with low attack-alert and high FNR; all primary metrics must be reported together.
interpretation_guardrails.asr: Not measured and not supported by E2 decision-level data. Attack-alert is not ASR, poisoning prevention, resolver outcome, or deployment performance.
